notes:
**New / changed behaviour**
- Ribbon remembers your choices — tool visibility decisions survive upgrades; only brand-new tools appear or hide according to their default
- Send Feedback tile can now be shown/hidden from Preferences like any other tool
- Match Viewports can now pick an alignment reference in the current model, not only inside a linked file
- Fix Line Patterns shows every pattern and its exact dash/space lengths and asks for confirmation before writing anything
- Suspend Viewports removed — it could leave viewports stranded off-sheet if Revit was closed mid-suspend
- Ribbon icons update immediately when you switch Revit between light and dark themes
- 
**Bug fixes**
- Match Sheet Positions no longer places two views on top of each other when the same reference viewport was the best match for more than one view
- Find & Replace (Project scope) no longer freezes while typing; a literal $ in the replacement text is now written as typed
- Perp Sections completes as one undo step and no longer leaves a magenta highlight stuck on the primary section if you cancel
- Toggle Box Visibility / Toggle Section Box no longer shows Revit's raw error dialog on sheets, schedules, and legends — you get a clear message instead
- Copy VG Settings no longer pushes the yellow crop highlight onto the undo stack (previously added two extra undo entries per run)
- AutoSync toast can no longer get stuck on screen for the rest of the session; opening Preferences and saving no longer resets your custom save/sync intervals; the enable toggle and the settings sub-dialog now stay in sync with each other
- Update check respects its 6-hour cooldown again instead of checking GitHub on every Revit start
- Tool toasts no longer reappear over a dialog after switching away from Revit and back
- 
**Security**
- The auto-updater now verifies the downloaded updater.ps1 against a SHA-256 checksum published in the release manifest and refuses to run it if they don't match
